```plato

    //==
    // Crossing an edge, and turning around a vertex.

    // The corner running the opposite way along the same undirected edge: the
    // one whose vertex is this corner's destination and whose destination is
    // this corner's vertex. Returns the "none" index when there is none (a
    // boundary edge).
    TwinCorner(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): CornerIndex
    {
        var from = self.CornerVertex(corner);
        var to = self.CornerDestination(corner);
        return CornerIndex(self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(c => CornerIndex(c))
            .Reduce(-1, (found, other) =>
                self.CornerVertex(other).Equals(to) && self.CornerDestination(other).Equals(from)
                    ? other.Value
                    : found));
    }
```
